# `passportsim run`

Advance virtual time, or wait until a matcher fires.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `core` |
| MCP tool | `passport_run` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/run` |
| Scenario step | `wait` |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `advances_time`, `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim run [until] [--for <FOR>] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--stream <STREAM>] [--timeout <TIMEOUT>] [--wall-budget-ms <WALL_BUDGET_MS>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fail_if` | carried by `--json` | `array` of `string` | no | Matchers that fail the run. |
| `for` | `--for <FOR>` | `union` | no | Duration to advance. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `stream` | `--stream <STREAM>` | `"usj"` \| `"uart0"` | no | Console (usj). |
| `timeout` | `--timeout <TIMEOUT>` | `union` | no | Timeout, 10s. |
| `until` | `<until>` | `string` | no | Matcher. |
| `wall_budget_ms` | `--wall-budget-ms <WALL_BUDGET_MS>` | `integer` | no | Host budget in ms (30000). |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/run.input.json`](../schema/commands/run.input.json).

## Examples

### Advance 250 ms so a click is delivered

```sh
passportsim run --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "for": "250ms"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "for": "250ms"
}
'@ | passportsim run --json -
```

### Wait for a console line

```sh
passportsim run --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "timeout": "5s",
  "until": "serial:/pk_app: ready/"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "timeout": "5s",
  "until": "serial:/pk_app: ready/"
}
'@ | passportsim run --json -
```
